newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: 7 MO 97 GAS IMPORTS 1.489 BLN CUBIC METRES.
newsitem.headline: 7 MO 97 GAS IMPORTS 1.489 BLN CUBIC METRES.

text.p: Lithuanian Gas said on Friday that the country's gas imports amounted to 1.489 billion metres in the first seven months of the year compared to 1.469 billion metres in the same period in 1996.
Mindaugas Kirslys, the executive head of the firm's department of commerce, told Reuters that 939 million cubic metres of gas was bought by Lithuanian Gas in the first seven months of 1997.
Lithuanian Gas bought 979 million cubic metres of gas in the first seven months of 1996.
Achema, a fertiliser and chemical producer, bought 342 million cubic metres of gas in the first seven months of the year compared to 449 million cubic metres in the same period in 1996, Kirslys said.
Stellae Vitae firm bought 208 million cubic metres of gas in the first seven months of the year versus seven million tonnes in the same period in 1996, he added.
Kirslys also said that 269 million cubic metres of gas was transited to the Kaliningrad region in the first seven months of 1997 compared to 253 million cubic metres in the same period in 1996.
